question.text: Gold ETFs are allowed to invest in gold deposit schemes of banks up to what percentage of the net assets of the scheme?

explanation.text: The Logic: NISM-Series-X-A (pp.213-214) states that Gold ETFs may invest in gold deposit schemes of banks up to 20% of the net assets of the scheme. The balance is held in physical gold of prescribed purity or in permitted gold-linked instruments as described on the same pages. The Trap: The 20% limit applies specifically to bank gold deposit schemes; it is not a cap on the scheme's overall gold exposure. Note: Suggestions about Gold FoFs as a substitute when an investor lacks a demat account are not in the checked Gold ETF pages and should be cited from a separate source before being asserted.
